role: Common factual macro context supplied from the first draft to every condition, alongside the existing eleven-sector market packet and common task brief.

facts.label: Federal funds target range announced by FOMC
facts.source_excerpt: federal funds rate at 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent
facts.source_locator: Dated press release, first policy-decision paragraph
facts.release_vintage: Dated policy announcement; not a later statistical time-series extraction
facts.interpretation_note: This is a policy target range, not an observed effective rate or an assumed future rate.

facts.label: CPI-U all items change from previous month
facts.source_locator: Archive release header and opening CPI-U paragraphs; Table A
facts.release_vintage: June 2026 figures as printed in the July 14 release, not a current BLS API series
facts.interpretation_note: Monthly price change; do not interpret as an annual inflation rate.

facts.label: CPI-U all items change over twelve months
facts.source_excerpt: index increased 3.5 percent before seasonal adjustment
facts.source_locator: Archive release header and opening CPI-U paragraphs; Table A
facts.release_vintage: June 2026 figures as printed in the July 14 release, not a current BLS API series

facts.label: CPI-U excluding food and energy change over twelve months
facts.source_locator: Archive release header and opening CPI-U paragraphs; Table A
facts.release_vintage: June 2026 figures as printed in the July 14 release, not a current BLS API series
facts.interpretation_note: Core CPI excludes food and energy; it is not PCE inflation.

facts.label: Civilian unemployment rate
facts.source_locator: Archive release header and opening paragraph; Tables A-1 and B-1
facts.release_vintage: June 2026 first-release estimates; subsequent payroll revisions are excluded
facts.interpretation_note: Household-survey unemployment measure; not the payroll employment growth rate.

facts.label: Change in total nonfarm payroll employment
facts.source_locator: Archive release header and opening paragraph; Tables A-1 and B-1
facts.release_vintage: June 2026 first-release estimates; subsequent payroll revisions are excluded
facts.interpretation_note: First-release establishment-survey estimate; subsequent revisions are excluded.

facts.label: Real GDP change from previous quarter, annualized
facts.unit: percent quarter over quarter at annual rate
facts.source_locator: Release PDF page 1 and Real GDP and Related Measures table on page 3
facts.release_vintage: 2026 Q1 third estimate released June 25; later annual updates are excluded
facts.interpretation_note: Third estimate for January-March 2026; not Q2 growth, a year-over-year rate, or a forecast.

information_policy: Use these dated release values as the common information set. Observation periods and publication dates are different fields.
No fact in this packet implies a prescribed sector preference or allocation. A model may draw a conditional inference but must label it as its own inference and cite the relevant evidence IDs.
The target-date context is July 2026; do not insert knowledge of later outcomes, later statistical revisions, or today's market state.
A source outlook may have been written before these releases. Treat any resulting tension as dated evidence to explain, not as evidence that the outlook's author saw subsequent information.
scope_limitations: Compact public-release context is not an exhaustive professional information terminal, complete client mandate, or a forecast target.

These files were retrieved in October 2026 from official dated release archives. The original release date and retained release text support availability; there is no independently timestamped July download for this project.

Fed HTML and BEA PDF originals are saved. BLS direct downloads returned HTTP 403, so the accessible official archive text is retained as exact web-tool snapshots; these snapshots are explicitly not original HTML files.
The existing ETF adjusted-price input retains its current-vendor-vintage limitation. Adding release-vintage macro facts does not convert the full case into a verified point-in-time backtest.
GDP is lagged quarterly information; employment first estimates and seasonally adjusted series can be revised. This packet preserves the selected release vintage.

framework_reference.paper: PortBench: A Correlation-Aware, Full-Pipeline Benchmark for LLM-Driven Portfolio Management, v6
sections: Appendix B, Market context at decision time
framework_reference.supported_design: Provide macroeconomic context together with trailing asset statistics, correlations and explicit portfolio/task state. Section 2.1 explicitly includes interest rates and inflation measures.
framework_reference.not_claimed: This seven-fact subset, exact official series and the extra labor/activity indicators are not a verbatim PortBench replication or a paper-validated optimal feature set.

sector_allocation_reference.paper: Quek et al., Leveraging LLMs for Top-Down Sector Allocation in Automated Trading
sector_allocation_reference.latest_version_checked: v5, April 10, 2025; arXiv abstract submission history checked October 19, 2026
sector_allocation_reference.supported_design: Sector-allocation input categories explicitly include interest rates, inflation, employment and growth; CPI and nonfarm payrolls are named. Official release dates govern availability.
sector_allocation_reference.adaptation: Use a compact dated-release table instead of the paper's multi-agent macro memory pipeline, stock news and PMI. Do not import its asset ranks, trading parameters or performance claims.

macro_measurement_reference.paper: Zhao et al., Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators
macro_measurement_reference.latest_version_checked: v1, August 31, 2026; arXiv abstract submission history checked October 19, 2026
macro_measurement_reference.supported_design: The published variable table distinguishes real GDP quarterly annualized growth, CPI yearly growth, monthly nonfarm employment change and the unemployment-rate level, with explicit units and seasonal adjustment.
macro_measurement_reference.adaptation: These already-released indicators are background facts here, not nowcast targets. This reference supports variable definitions and temporal discipline, not optimal sector allocation or this seven-row subset's sufficiency.

selection_provenance.interest_rate: Paper-supported interest-rate category implemented using the dated official FOMC target-range announcement.
selection_provenance.inflation: Paper-supported inflation category implemented using headline monthly/yearly CPI-U and core yearly CPI-U from one dated BLS release.
selection_provenance.labor_context: Employment category and NFP are explicit in Quek et al. section 3. LiveMacroEval Table 2 defines both NFP monthly change and unemployment level. Transfer those categories to a compact common context using the original BLS release; do not import a regime label, weight or trading instruction.
selection_provenance.activity_context: Economic growth is explicit in Quek et al. section 3 (using PMI there); GDP QoQ SAAR is defined in LiveMacroEval Table 2. The local adaptation uses dated BEA GDP as a publicly archived activity measure and retains its quarter and estimate vintage; it is not asserted equivalent to PMI.
selection_provenance.selection_lock: Chosen before any v4.9.1 model output; same rows, values and ordering in every E/L and source condition. Do not add/remove facts after viewing an institutional contrast.
selection_provenance.omitted_from_minimal_context: No researcher-written sector outlook, causal trading rule, forecast, sentiment score or numerical macro-to-weight coefficient. No live FRED/current-vintage series substitutes for dated release figures.
